pay.q: Does my client pay for the app?
pay.a: No. The mobile app is free for your clients.

invite.q: How do I bring my clients over?
invite.a: Invite them by email from the portal. They install the app and land straight in your client list.

drafts.q: Will my client see unfinished weeks?
drafts.a: No. Clients only see the weeks you publish. Drafts stay hidden until you are ready.

share.q: Can a trainer and a nutritionist share a client?
share.a: Yes. Each of you owns your own plan, and the client sees both in one app.

reuse.q: Can I reuse plans across clients?
reuse.a: Yes. Save sessions, meals or a whole plan as a template and give it to the next client in one click.

languages.q: Which languages does Form Up speak?
languages.a: Czech, English and German — in the web portal and in the mobile app.
